question: The world’s largest camel fair is held in which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pushkar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The world's largest camel fair is held in **Pushkar**, a town in the Ajmer district in the Indian state of Rajasthan.
 
• The Pushkar Camel Fair, also known as the Pushkar Fair or Pushkar ka Mela, is an annual multi-day livestock fair and cultural event.
